briefdescription.para: QRingInfo_field specialisation for QQ coefficients, which need denominator tracking through reductions.

detaileddescription.para: Implements normal_form and gbvector_normal_form plus the three-argument gbvector_normal_form(F, f, use_denom, denom) overload that accumulates the cleared denominator. The reduction itself goes through reduce_lead_term_QQ.
